mapper.select: SELECT level FROM reading_level_rule ORDER BY level

SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(p.earned_level,0),COALESCE((SELECT MAX(level) FROM reading_level_rule WHERE min_seconds<=COALESCE(p.total_millis,0) DIV 1000),0)) AS level,COUNT(*) AS amount FROM user_info u LEFT JOIN user_reading_progress p ON p.user_id=u.user_id WHERE 1=1 AND u.data_source=#{source}
GROUP BY level

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_revision r LEFT JOIN article_info a ON a.article_id=r.article_id WHERE r.deleted=0 AND r.is_current=1 AND r.state IN(0,1,3,4) AND (a.article_id IS NULL OR (a.deleted=0 AND a.status=0)) AND r.data_source=#{source}

SELECT status,COUNT(*) AS amount FROM article_info WHERE deleted=0 AND data_source=#{source}
GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.user_id) FROM user_reading_daily d JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=d.user_id WHERE d.read_day>=#{start} AND d.read_day<#{end} AND d.total_millis>0 AND u.data_source=#{source}

SELECT CAST(d.read_day AS CHAR) AS day,SUM(d.total_millis) AS millis,COUNT(*) AS readers FROM user_reading_daily d JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=d.user_id WHERE d.read_day>=#{start} AND d.read_day<#{end} AND d.total_millis>0 AND u.data_source=#{source}
GROUP BY d.read_day
